mentions.name: bgtk
mentions.description: A toolkit built for the bgce experimental display server, letting programs write directly to a buffer that appears on screen with very little abstraction.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am build a toolkit for it too:

https://terminal.pink/bgtk/index.html

Or https://github.com/blmayer/bgtk

I think it is nice that we can just write to a buffer and it appears on the screen. Very little abstraction is needed.
